notes: Representative chat questions for load tests, drawn from the same in-memory keyword corpus and deterministic backend the quality harness uses so runs are reproducible offline. The mix is retrieval-heavy with a minority of direct-answer, rewrite-triggering, and insufficient-evidence questions so cached/uncached and basic/agentic comparisons are meaningful.
